If I cancel, how long until I'm refunded?
Once we successfully cancel your order, we issue the refund straight away on our side. How quickly it appears on your statement depends on your payment provider:
Debit/credit cards, Apple Pay/Google Pay: usually 3–5 business days, but some banks can take up to 10 business days.
PayPal: typically instant to 48 hours.
You’ll receive a cancellation confirmation email as soon as it’s done. If you don’t see the refund after 10 business days, reply here and I’ll look into it for you.
If you’d like me to try to cancel your order now, please share your order number and postcode and I’ll check the status right away.

Can I combine two separate orders into one shipment?
We’re not able to combine two separate orders into a single shipment once they’ve been placed. Here are your options:
Keep both orders as they are. If they share the same delivery date and address, they may arrive around the same time, but it’s not guaranteed and shipping charges remain separate.
If you’d prefer everything in one order, we can try to cancel the existing order(s) so you can place a new combined order—this is only possible if they haven’t started processing.
If you’d like me to attempt a cancellation, please reply with your order number(s) and your postcode. I’ll check the status right away and see what’s possible.
